payload.subject: Adapter configuration consolidated: declared vs detected
payload.name: Adapter configuration consolidated: declared vs detected
payload.goal: Adapter configuration has no home. It is spread across five places with no authority order and no schema. (a) .synth/config.yaml holds a single `git:` block, parsed ad hoc by three independent modules (ledger/branch.ts:74, adapter/git-snapshot.ts:338, repository/branch-policy.ts) with no type, no loader module and no validation, so an unknown or misspelled key is silently ignored. (b) `synth init` writes detection results into the generated manifest under `adapters: {selected, config, diagnostics}` (cli/synth.ts:3070-3090) - a regenerable document, and absent from this repository manifest altogether. (c) .synth/context.json persists a repository classification (`repositoryType: brownfield-polyglot`, confidence, derivedFrom) but no adapter configuration. (d) `synth adapter configure repository path=. remote=origin defaultBranch=main promotionMode=direct` (cli/adapter.ts:11,74-86) is accepted and then lost: GitRepositoryAdapter.configure (adapters/repository/git.ts:187-199) merges into in-memory state and never writes, so the verb has no durable effect across a process restart. (e) Forge credentials are split between env GITHUB_TOKEN and a config schema that declares `token` required (adapters/github/adapter.ts:72), which invites a personal access token into tracked YAML. The consequence is measured, not theoretical: detectRecommendedAdapters already computes defaultBranch and remote (cli/detect-adapters.ts:113-119) and both are dropped, so the same fact is hardcoded three separate times (ledger/delivery.ts:347 defaults baseBranches to ["origin/main","main"] and no caller ever passes the option; ledger/branch.ts:49 LEDGER_FALLBACK_BRANCH = "main"; cli/adapter.ts:81 defaultBranch || "main"). Outcome required: (1) a typed `adapters:` section in .synth/config.yaml - adapters.repository.{provider,remote,baseBranch,snapshots,hooks} and adapters.forge.{provider,owner,repo,baseUrl} - read through one new loader module with schema validation that warns on unknown keys. (2) Detected observations written to .synth/cache/adapters.json (gitignored, artifact class `cache` per state/artifact-policy.ts:58, same precedent as dependency-records.json), each carrying value, confidence and derivedFrom, and including a git BINARY probe so that "git is not installed" is distinguishable from "git is installed but this directory is not a repository". Today first-contact onboard:detect returns byte-identical output for both cases and advises `synth adapter init` even when git is absent, which is advice the operator cannot follow. (3) A documented and tested authority order: CLI flag, then config.yaml, then cached detection, then built-in default - where the built-in default is provider none declaring no capabilities, never origin/main. (4) The three hardcoded branch defaults deleted and fed from configuration through the baseBranches option ledger/delivery.ts:347 already accepts. (5) `synth adapter configure --approve` promotes a detection proposal into config.yaml, plan-then-approve in the same shape as first-contact onboard --approve; this single mechanism is what makes the greenfield offer ("git is installed, this is not a repository - initialise it?") and the brownfield offer ("a repository and a GitHub remote were detected - configure the forge adapter?") the same code path. (6) Credentials resolved from env or a secret store only, with `token` removed from the GitHub adapter required config schema. (7) The existing `git:` block migrated to adapters.repository.* with a deprecation warning on read, and `git.ledgerBranch` retired: the ledger branch is inferred from the checkout when it matches branchPolicy.declaredPatterns, with trunk as the last resort rather than the first. (8) The ledger-branch fallback order corrected - a stale configured value plus a stale .synth/data/ledger.json record (currently arena/c5db653e-synth) resolve to local `main` today, which would commit governance state onto the trunk branch instead of the declared operator checkout; a checkout matching a declared pattern must win over trunk. Acceptance: the three-system matrix (no git at all / git installed without a repository / git installed with a repository) yields distinct, truthful recognition output and identical ledger behaviour in all three; no repository or branch value is hardcoded outside the loader documented defaults; `synth adapter configure` survives a process restart; no secret can be written into .synth/config.yaml; and the ledger records ceremonies with zero VCS present, reporting verification as unavailable rather than failing.
